Verify rewrite DATA ONLY. Do not write improved examples or solve the user's task.
Read every input and target in full. Return one review per exact id and row_sha256.
input_verdict checks plausible natural drafts or dictation, recoverable intent, contradictions,
fake noise, padding and leaked authoring instructions. output_verdict checks natural appropriate
language and formatting. pair_verdict checks ALL facts, uncertainty, conditions, negation,
quantities, names, quotations, literals, requests versus assertions, and the supplied mode.
/transcribe permits punctuation, true disfluency removal and explicit corrections, not lexical
paraphrasing. Preserve meaningful words like German 'um' and 'er', colloquial Portuguese and
unfinished thoughts. /slack is casual minimal cleanup; a long input may be a pasted thread.
/prompt reorganizes a self-contained request and never answers it. It must not drop supplied
material, hedges or constraints. /polish improves prose without omissions or changed certainty.
Identity inputs must remain byte-identical. Apply only supplied dictionary/profile context.
Check long texts paragraph by paragraph. Fail concrete defects. Uncertain means not confidently
justifiable. Pass requires no material defect. Overall verdict is fail if any dimension fails,
uncertain if any dimension is uncertain and none fails, otherwise pass. Give a concrete critique
for EVERY pair, citing the changed detail for defects. These are model judgments, not human labels.

Both paths need a box for cake/message details, a quantity field, and a place to note common allergens. Please include a short intro saying orders need 48 hours' notice and aren't confirmed until bakery staff calls the customer. Don't imply immediate confirmation or payment; we haven't decided whether payment will be collected online. Keep it straightforward for phone users and make it clear which fields are relevant before someone starts typing. Don't write a menu, prices, or a sample order. Could you turn this into a prompt for a designer to produce the field labels and concise helper text? Do not create the actual form.", "output": "Write the copy and field order for a small bakery's online order form. Customers should choose pickup or local delivery first, and the form should show the fields relevant to their choice.

- If a customer chooses pickup, show a pickup date and a 30-minute pickup window. Ask for their name and phone number, and do not show a delivery address field.
- If a customer chooses local delivery, show the delivery address and requested delivery date. Ask for their name and phone number, and do not show a pickup date or pickup window. Add a short note beside the delivery option that delivery is available only within 5 miles of the shop. Do not include a map or extra location checker.

Both paths need a cake/message details box, a quantity field, and a place to note common allergens. Include a short introduction stating that orders need 48 hours' notice and are not confirmed until bakery staff calls the customer. Do not imply immediate confirmation or payment; it has not been decided whether payment will be collected online.

Keep the form straightforward for phone users and make it clear which fields apply before customers start typing. Provide field labels and concise helper text, but do not create the form or include a menu, prices, or a sample order."}]
